narrative: On the board. Nine short passages in your hand, still loose, the candle at the left. The company's book is not in the room. On the board. You turn the top sheet. Nothing is struck. The writing-tables are shut on the shelf.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Counted the sheets and left them unbound.

entities.name: Kemp's nine lines
entities.context: Shown on draft in Nine lines, not yet in the book
